offense.wideZone: Shanahan wide zone: outside-zone runs, heavy play-action and bootlegs, yards after the catch
offense.mcvay: McVay tree: wide zone from 11 personnel, condensed formations, timing routes and play-action
offense.westCoast: West Coast: short, rhythm passing, backs and tight ends in the pass game, screens
offense.erhardtPerkins: Erhardt-Perkins: concept-based passing, tight-end heavy, power and duo runs
offense.spread: Spread and RPO: quarterback runs and options, wide splits, tempo
offense.vertical: Vertical passing: Air Coryell and Air Raid roots, deep shots, five-man protections
offense.gapMotion: Gap and motion: pre-snap motion, gap and duo runs, play-action shots

defense.fangio: Fangio two-high 3-4: light boxes, disguised two-deep shells, few blitzes, limits big plays
defense.cover3: Seattle 4-3: single-high Cover 3, wide-nine rushers, fast linebackers
defense.pressure: Pressure: blitz-heavy, man coverage behind it, boom-or-bust
defense.multiple: Belichick multiple: week-to-week game plans built to take away the opponent's best option
defense.macdonald: Macdonald multiple: simulated pressures and late rotation to confuse quarterbacks
